SELECT id, budget_type, target_id, daily_limit, monthly_limit, per_request_limit, max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens, allow_overrun, enabled, currency, remark, created_at, updated_at, max_requests, max_concurrency, max_agent_steps, max_tool_calls, alert_threshold, overrun_policy FROM ai_budget_policy WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, budget_type, target_id, daily_limit, monthly_limit, per_request_limit, max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens, allow_overrun, enabled, currency, remark, created_at, updated_at, max_requests, max_concurrency, max_agent_steps, max_tool_calls, alert_threshold, overrun_policy FROM ai_budget_policy WHERE budget_type = #{budgetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND enabled = 1 LIMIT 1
